- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Interactive toys can encourage physical activity and mental stimulation for pets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for interactive toys include:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Food Puzzle Toys: Examples include Kongs, Tricky Treat Ball, and Nina Ottosson Dog Brick.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Treat-Dispensing Toys: Examples include Buster Cube, Outward Hound Brick Puzzle, and Pet Zone Treat Wobbler.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Interactive Play Toys: Examples include wand toys (e.g., Da Bird, GoCat), interactive laser pointers, and hide-and-seek toys (e.g., Hide-A-Squirrel, Snuffle Mats).
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Obstacle Course Toys: Suggested using tunnels, cones, or jumps.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sensory Toys: Examples include crinkle toys, sensory mats, and interactive scratching posts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Introduce new toys gradually and in moderation to prevent overwhelming Luna.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Consult with a veterinarian before starting any new exercise or play routine.
